title: Cold rebuild: TaskItem
summary: Write Sidekick's task class again from a blank editor, with no hints, before the boss.

steps.title: From memory, on purpose
body: A **cold rebuild** is one piece of your Sidekick written again from a blank editor: no starter, no hints, no solution, and the very same tests as the first time.

Today it is `TaskItem` from the constructors lesson: the class every later piece (the journal, the reports, the assistant) depends on. Pulling it out of memory now is what makes it yours; if a rule has slipped, you find out here instead of in the boss.
> **Tip:** Start with the property list, then the constructor's three checks, then the four methods. Run the checks after each one.

steps.prompt: A task's timer started at 10:00. What does `Stop(9:00)` do?
options: Throws `ArgumentException`, and the timer keeps running
steps.explain: A timer cannot stop before it started: that is a bad argument. Because the check comes before anything changes, the task is untouched and still running.

steps.title: Cold rebuild: TaskItem
prompt: Rebuild from memory: `class TaskItem`, valid from the start. Same tests as the constructors lesson.

- `TaskItem(int id, string title, int estimateMinutes = 0)`: id below 1 throws `ArgumentOutOfRangeException`; blank title `ArgumentException`; negative estimate `ArgumentOutOfRangeException`; the title is stored trimmed.
- `Start(DateTime at)`: a done task throws `InvalidOperationException`; running already does nothing.
- `int Stop(DateTime at)`: 0 when not running; `at` before `StartedAt` throws `ArgumentException`; else adds and returns the whole minutes.
- `Log(int minutes)`: below 1 throws `ArgumentOutOfRangeException`. `Complete()`: done, timer stopped.
solution: public TaskItem(int id, string title, int estimateMinutes = 0)
if (id < 1) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(id), "Task ids start at 1.");
if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(title)) throw new ArgumentException("A task needs a title.", nameof(title));
if (estimateMinutes < 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(estimateMinutes), "An estimate cannot be negative.");
public int LoggedMinutes { get; private set; }
public bool IsRunning { get; private set; }
public DateTime StartedAt { get; private set; }
public bool Done { get; private set; }
if (Done) throw new InvalidOperationException("A finished task cannot be started.");
if (at < StartedAt) throw new ArgumentException("A timer cannot stop before it started.", nameof(at));
if (minutes < 1) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(minutes), "Log at least one minute.");
template: var dojoT = new TaskItem(1, "  Fix login  ", 45);
Dojo.Eq("Id is stored", 1, dojoT.Id);
Dojo.Eq("the title is trimmed", "Fix login", dojoT.Title);
Dojo.Eq("the estimate is stored", 45, dojoT.EstimateMinutes);
Dojo.Eq("the estimate defaults to 0", 0, new TaskItem(2, "Docs").EstimateMinutes);
Dojo.Eq("a new task is not done", false, dojoT.Done);
Dojo.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>("id 0 is refused", () => new TaskItem(0, "x"));
Dojo.Throws<ArgumentException>("a blank title is refused", () => new TaskItem(3, "   "));
Dojo.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>("a negative estimate is refused", () => new TaskItem(4, "x", -5));
dojoT.Start(new DateTime(2026, 11, 24, 9, 0, 0));
Dojo.Eq("StartedAt is remembered", new DateTime(2026, 11, 24, 9, 0, 0), dojoT.StartedAt);
Dojo.Eq("Stop returns the minutes", 50, dojoT.Stop(new DateTime(2026, 11, 24, 9, 50, 0)));
dojoT.Start(new DateTime(2026, 11, 24, 10, 0, 0));
Dojo.Throws<ArgumentException>("stopping before the start is refused", () => dojoT.Stop(new DateTime(2026, 11, 24, 9, 0, 0)));
Dojo.Eq("after a refused Stop the timer still runs", true, dojoT.IsRunning);
Dojo.Eq("then a real Stop works", 10, dojoT.Stop(new DateTime(2026, 11, 24, 10, 10, 0)));
dojoT.Log(15);
Dojo.Eq("Log adds minutes", 75, dojoT.LoggedMinutes);
Dojo.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>("Log(0) is refused", () => dojoT.Log(0));
dojoT.Start(new DateTime(2026, 11, 24, 11, 0, 0));
dojoT.Complete();
Dojo.Eq("Complete sets Done", true, dojoT.Done);
Dojo.Eq("Complete stops the timer", false, dojoT.IsRunning);
Dojo.Throws<InvalidOperationException>("a done task cannot start", () => dojoT.Start(new DateTime(2026, 11, 24, 12, 0, 0)));
Dojo.Check("Title cannot be changed from outside", typeof(TaskItem).GetProperty("Title")?.SetMethod is null, "make Title get-only");
Dojo.Check("LoggedMinutes has no public setter", typeof(TaskItem).GetProperty("LoggedMinutes")?.SetMethod?.IsPublic != true, "use { get; private set; }");
Dojo.Check("Done has no public setter", typeof(TaskItem).GetProperty("Done")?.SetMethod?.IsPublic != true, "use { get; private set; }");
